body: Create an animation-ready modular 2D cel shaded fantasy game cutout atlas, Arcane Vanguard style, bold clean dark outlines, painterly cel shading, detailed but readable at small size. Landscape high-resolution image on TRUE transparent alpha. SIX separate equally sized panels arranged THREE columns TWO rows. View directions reading order: E right profile, SE front-right threequarter, SW front-left threequarter, W left profile, NW rear-left threequarter, NE rear-right threequarter. Rear views show BACK of head/hair, BACK of clothing, no face or front chest ornament. Every panel contains exactly12 ISOLATED BODY PIECES in3columns4rows, consistent local ordering: row1 head, upper torso from neck to waist ONLY, rear cape; row2 pelvis/skirt, anatomical left upperarm, right upperarm; row3 left forearm including hand, right forearm including hand, left leg without foot; row4 right leg without foot, left boot, right boot. No full figures. Head entirely detached from torso. Arms split at elbows. Legs stop at ankles. NO equipment or effects in body sheet. Large transparent gutters between every cutout and everypanel. Avoid labels, checkerboard, background, panels, borders. Do not connect pieces. Full consistent identity across six genuine rotations. Subject: Hellbinder muscular red-skinned demon jailer with short swept-back horns, cruel angular face, black iron shoulder harness, charcoal leather tunic and broad belt, wrapped forearms with iron cuffs, armored dark boots. One scarred shoulder, chain-ring ornament on chest. Empty hands; hooked chain weapon separate. CRITICAL layout THREE panels across TWO panels down, not six columns. Eachpanel3columns4rows,72piece total. TORSO has NO arms attached, detached empty shoulderopenings. SW head looks LEFT, rearNW/NEshow BACKOFHEAD. No sixcolumn layout.
